title: Eddoboozi eryegatta ku nsozi
intro: Omwoyo omutuukirivu gwaweebwa ebirabo eby’enjawulo okuva mu ggulu, n’efuuka omufuzi era omulwanyi ng’obutonde bwe bwennyini bulabika nga bukwatagana n’obutonzi bwennyini. Emboozi yaabwe eluka okuyita mu bunnabbi, obwakabaka, n’emikono, n’elekawo omusika oguwulikika mu mpapula z’okubikkulirwa okw’obwakatonda.
clues: Nalondebwa ng’omuweereza wa Allah era ne nweebwa obwakabaka obw’amaanyi mu bantu abalonde.
Ensozi n’ebinyonyi byandiwulikika nange mu kugulumiza Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo.
Ekyuma kyafuuka kigonvu ng’ebbumba mu ngalo zange, olw’okwagala kwa Allah yekka.
Nnakola ebyokulwanyisa eby’obukuumi ebyakuuma abalwanyi mu bbugumu ly’olutalo.
Lumu nnayita mu kigezo ekizibu, abantu babiri abaali bakaayana bwe bamenya mu kifo we nnali nsinziza nga sisuubira.
Njogerwako ku mabbali g’omufuzi eyaduumira empewo n’amajinni — kubanga omufuzi oyo yali zzadde lyange ddala.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Abantu babiri abaali bakaayana baamenya ekifo we nnali nsinziza
Yayolekagana n’amataba amanene agaasaanyaawo abantu bange
Yasuulibwa mu muliro ogwaka ennyo abantu bange
trial.answer: Abantu babiri abaali bakaayana baamenya ekifo we nnali nsinziza

location.label: Ekintu Ekikulu
options: Ekyuma kyakolebwa pliable mu ngalo zange
Olusuku olulungi ennyo nga lulimu ebika by’ebibala bibiri
location.answer: Ekyuma kyakolebwa pliable mu ngalo zange

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Yanunuddwa okuva mu lubuto lw’ekyennyanja era abantu ne bakkiriza
Yanunula abantu bange mu mikono gy’omutyobooli
Yaweebwa obufuzi ku mpewo ne majinni
Yazzibwa mu bulamu obulungi era n’aweebwa emikisa egy’enjawulo

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
